Chapter 129: Chapter 14: Ten Thousand Years (Please Subscribe)_3

Even if he still hadn’t figured out the Evolution Path in the end, at least he had tried and had not given up easily.

Thus, Gu Ze would have a reason, after the test ended, to include Lalin Yuan in the Red Kun Lineage.

However, now, seeing Lin Yuan lying on the ground having completely given up, Gu Ze began to doubt his own judgement.

“Junior brother.”

“Let it be.”

“This person’s perseverance is too weak, even if they possess strong comprehension, their future achievements would be limited.”

Two figures beside him tried to persuade Gu Ze.

...

They even felt that Gu Ze did not need to take Lin Yuan as his disciple anymore.

After all, nurturing a disciple in the Red Kun Lineage requires resources, especially in the early stages.

“So be it.”

Gu Ze sighed internally.

He also felt that Lin Yuan’s perseverance was lacking.

To become strong, aptitude is one aspect, comprehension another, but strong perseverance is equally necessary.

Encountering any issue, without even attempting to address it, surrendering proactively, such a person would achieve nothing.

…

Time slowly passed.

Another couple of days went by.

This day was Lin Yuan’s twenty-ninth in the Seventh Star Cave.

According to the rules of the Seventh Star Cave test, if Lin Yuan hadn’t figured out the Evolution Path by the next day, he would be expelled from the Seven Star Cave World.

“Why is that person lying there?”

“I don’t know.”

“Maybe they are tired?”

Lin Yuan’s actions also drew the attention of other test takers.

However, these test takers just took another look, as their main goal at the moment was to pass the Seventh Star Cave.

No test taker had the time to meddle too much.

Just then.

Lin Yuan, who had been lying motionless on the ground for nearly ten days, suddenly opened his eyes.

“So that’s how it is.”

In the depths of Lin Yuan’s eyes, a vast starry sky was faintly reflected.

An extremely profound aura began to condense within Lin Yuan’s body.

Because Lin Yuan was lying on the ground, parts of his skin were in contact with the mountain peak beneath his feet.

At the moment this profound aura appeared,

the entire mountain peak began to tremble.

For a time,

the remaining dozens of Evolvers were thrown into panic, abruptly stopping their contemplation, and standing up to look around.

The tremor of the mountain didn’t stop; it even seemed to intensify.

Mysterious Space.

Shock appeared on the faces of twelve figures.

The main peak of the Seventh Star Cave trembling was something that hadn’t happened in nearly ten thousand years.

“What is this?”

Among the top three figures, the one in the lead, as if realizing something, had his expression suddenly change.

“The final test.”

“Someone has passed the final test.”

The other two figures quickly caught on.

The nine figures below all stood up, looking towards the Seventh Star Cave again, as if searching for something.

…

In a vast grand hall,

an old man dressed in a red robe, was sitting on a throne, his eyes half-closed, dozing off.

“Star Lord, Star Lord.”

It was then that the voice of an intelligent assistant came, waking up the red-robed old man.

“What is it?”

“Don’t you know I’m in seclusion?”

The Chikun Star Lord did not open his eyes, but frowned and muttered.

“Speak.”

Chikun Star Lord spoke again, knowing that something capable of interrupting his seclusion must be no small matter.

“In the Seven Star Cave World, someone has passed the final test.”

The intelligent assistant quickly said.

“The final test?”

Upon hearing this, the Chikun Star Lord’s eyes silently opened.

Boom.

A terrifying heat quickly spread thousands of miles, the Chikun Star Lord’s eyes shone like two constant stars illuminating in all directions.

Hum.

The Chikun Star Lord connected his consciousness to the Virtual World, overlooking the whole Seven Star Cave World, his gaze directed towards the continuously trembling mountain peak of the Seventh Star Cave.

Immediately, he returned to reality, sitting on the throne in the center of the palace, slowly closing his eyes, isolating light and heat.

“Ten thousand years.”
